clauses.title: 1. SUBSCRIPTION FEES AND BILLING
clauses.text: 1. SUBSCRIPTION FEES AND BILLING. Customer shall pay monthly subscription fees of $8,500.00 within thirty (30) days of invoice date. Overdue amounts incur interest at 1.5% per month.

clauses.title: 2. UNILATERAL CUSTOMER INDEMNIFICATION
clauses.text: 2. UNILATERAL CUSTOMER INDEMNIFICATION. Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Provider against all third-party claims, liabilities, and legal expenses arising from Customer data.

clauses.title: 3. AGGREGATE LIABILITY CAP
clauses.text: 3. AGGREGATE LIABILITY CAP. Total liability of Provider shall not exceed the total fees paid by Customer in the six (6) months prior to the incident.

clauses.title: 4. TERMINATION FOR CONVENIENCE
clauses.text: 4. TERMINATION FOR CONVENIENCE. Provider may terminate this agreement at will upon thirty (30) days notice without refund of prepaid subscription fees.
